close_reason:
Extended email_copy's # Errors section with a dedicated '# Cross-account error space (RFC 8620 §5.4 + RFC 8621 §4.7)' header documenting the full method-specific error code list:

- fromAccountNotFound (source account inaccessible)
- fromAccountNotSupportedByMethod (source account does not support Mail)
- stateMismatch (destroyFromIfInState did not match)
- tooManyCopies (server-defined cap on copies-per-request)
- tooManyEmails (server-defined cap on emails-per-copy)
- anchorNotFound (under #-prefixed result references)

Plus an explicit note that per-entry failures (one per creation key in 'create') appear in SetResponse::not_created as SetError values, NOT as method-level errors, with the per-entry code list (invalidProperties, notFound, overQuota, alreadyExists). The existing brief mention added by JMAP-tjvm.33 listed only 3 of the 6 method-level codes; this commit completes the spec coverage.

email_import already has documented its error space adequately in the prior JMAP-tjvm.33 commit; that method's not_created shape is explicitly noted there with the per-entry error code list. No further changes needed.

The bead's broader 'same pattern should apply to email_import' was already addressed by JMAP-tjvm.33.
title: email_copy: cross-account error space not documented (fromAccountNotFound, anchorNotFound, etc.)
